t: Gagauzia's Head Election Heads to Runoff After No Candidate Secures Majority
d: Preliminary data from Moldova's Central Election Commission (CEC) following the count of 100% of ballots shows the race for the head of the Gagauz autonomy is advancing to a second round.

t: Beijing Confirms Xi Jinping to Meet With Putin, Trump on November 19
d: The Chinese Foreign Ministry announced that President Xi Jinping would hold a meeting with Russian President Vladimir Putin and US President Donald Trump on November 19 in the city of Shenzhen.

t: Russian Drones Target Port and Rail Infrastructure Supporting Ukrainian Army
d: The Russian armed forces hit a naval vessel delivering military and dual-use cargo for the armed forces of Ukraine to the port of Chernomorsk, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Monday.

t: Rostec Rolls Out Enhanced Depesha-MK Robotic System
d: The new robot has a more spacious cargo compartment, more powerful engines and is capable of towing heavier trailers, says Rostec, Russia’s state corporation.

t: XI-Putin-Trump Meeting at APEC Summit Has ‘Historic and Pioneering Significance’ – Chinese MFA
d: The leaders of China, Russia, and the US will exchange views on maintaining peace, and the three countries bear responsibility for addressing global challenges and promoting peace and stability, the Chinese Foreign Ministry said.

t: Russian Army Advances Across Front Lines in Ukraine
d: Ukraine lost up to 330 soldiers in combat against Russia's Tsentr battlegroup over the past day, in addition to losses in manpower and equipment on other fronts, the Russian Defense Ministry said on Monday.
